versions.changelog:
wechat-work-hot-trend v0.1.0

- Initial release of the skill for extracting and summarizing publicly available content from WeChat Work (企业微信) share pages.
- Supports information extraction from public announcements, application pages, and group invitation pages.
- Only processes content that is publicly accessible; does not access or automate internal API routes.
- Summarizes key fields such as title, author, update time, content excerpt, and application information.
- Complies with platform data security guidelines, handling no private or internal data.
